chart_config.title: NIBRS offense rate trends for New York City, NY

baseline.explanation:
This returns annual reported murders rates per 100,000 for New York City, NY for the default last five complete calendar years. Named city police departments are resolved to city-agency ORIs; named sheriff agencies are resolved through the agency crosswalk. Person crimes use victim summaries while robbery and other non-person offenses use offense summaries. Rates use each agency's year-specific service population and are left blank unless the agency reported all 12 months. Recent annual values may still change as agencies submit revisions.

Period: 2021-2025.
baseline.sql:
WITH target_places AS (
  SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'New York City, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0303000' AS ori, 2021 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'New York City, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0303000' AS ori, 2022 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'New York City, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0303000' AS ori, 2023 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'New York City, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0303000' AS ori, 2024 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'New York City, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0303000' AS ori, 2025 AS effective_year
),
series_counts AS (
  SELECT s.year, tp.place_key, 'murder' AS offense_key, SUM(s.victim_count) AS reported_count
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_victim_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_svcm_ori
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
    AND s.ucr_offense_code = '09A'
    AND s.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
  GROUP BY s.year, tp.place_key
),
requested_years(year) AS (VALUES (2021), (2022), (2023), (2024), (2025)),
current_year_reporting AS (
  SELECT tp.place_key, COUNT(DISTINCT s.month) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_scm_ori_year
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori AND s.year = 2026
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
  GROUP BY tp.place_key
),
place_reporting AS (
  SELECT y.year, tp.place_key, MAX(a.population) AS population, MAX(c.months_reported) AS months_reported, MAX(cyr.summary_months_reported) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM requested_years AS y
  CROSS JOIN target_places AS tp
  LEFT JOIN agencies AS a ON a.ori = tp.ori AND a.year = y.year AND a.population > 0
  LEFT JOIN nibrs_agency_completeness AS c INDEXED BY idx_nac_ori_year
    ON c.ori = tp.ori AND c.year = y.year
  LEFT JOIN current_year_reporting AS cyr ON cyr.place_key = tp.place_key AND y.year = 2026
  WHERE tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = y.year
  GROUP BY y.year, tp.place_key
)
SELECT pr.year,
  CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.months_reported END) = 12 THEN ROUND(100000.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.place_key = 'place_1' AND sc.offense_key = 'murder' THEN sc.reported_count END), 0) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.population END), 0), 1) ELSE NULL END AS new_york_city_ny_murders_rate_per_100k
FROM place_reporting AS pr LEFT JOIN series_counts AS sc ON sc.year = pr.year AND sc.place_key = pr.place_key
GROUP BY pr.year
ORDER BY pr.year
LIMIT 1000

items.question: Allentown murder rate 2026

request.routing_reason: Recent monthly data from the Current Trends sample

baseline.explanation:
This returns annual reported murders rates per 100,000 for Allentown, PA for the requested year. Named city police departments are resolved to city-agency ORIs; named sheriff agencies are resolved through the agency crosswalk. Person crimes use victim summaries while robbery and other non-person offenses use offense summaries. Rates use each agency's year-specific service population and are left blank unless the agency reported all 12 months. Recent annual values may still change as agencies submit revisions.

Period: 2026.
baseline.sql:
WITH target_places AS (
  SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Allentown, PA' AS place_label, 'PA0390100' AS ori, 2026 AS effective_year
),
series_counts AS (
  SELECT s.year, tp.place_key, 'murder' AS offense_key, SUM(s.victim_count) AS reported_count
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_victim_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_svcm_ori
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
    AND s.ucr_offense_code = '09A'
    AND s.year = 2026
  GROUP BY s.year, tp.place_key
),
requested_years(year) AS (VALUES (2026)),
current_year_reporting AS (
  SELECT tp.place_key, COUNT(DISTINCT s.month) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_scm_ori_year
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori AND s.year = 2026
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
  GROUP BY tp.place_key
),
place_reporting AS (
  SELECT y.year, tp.place_key, MAX(a.population) AS population, MAX(c.months_reported) AS months_reported, MAX(cyr.summary_months_reported) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM requested_years AS y
  CROSS JOIN target_places AS tp
  LEFT JOIN agencies AS a ON a.ori = tp.ori AND a.year = y.year AND a.population > 0
  LEFT JOIN nibrs_agency_completeness AS c INDEXED BY idx_nac_ori_year
    ON c.ori = tp.ori AND c.year = y.year
  LEFT JOIN current_year_reporting AS cyr ON cyr.place_key = tp.place_key AND y.year = 2026
  WHERE tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = y.year
  GROUP BY y.year, tp.place_key
)
SELECT pr.year,
  CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.months_reported END) = 12 THEN ROUND(100000.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.place_key = 'place_1' AND sc.offense_key = 'murder' THEN sc.reported_count END), 0) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.population END), 0), 1) ELSE NULL END AS allentown_pa_murders_rate_per_100k
FROM place_reporting AS pr LEFT JOIN series_counts AS sc ON sc.year = pr.year AND sc.place_key = pr.place_key
GROUP BY pr.year
ORDER BY pr.year
LIMIT 1000

Murder counts and rates per 100,000 population for the top 100 U.S. cities, including St. Louis, Birmingham, Jackson, Kansas City, Memphis, Dayton, Fort Pierce, Shreveport, Detroit, Portsmouth, Albany, Flint, Baltimore, Owensboro, and High Point.

items.question: Which violent crime saw the greatest decrease in Chicago in 2025?

request.routing_reason: Recent monthly data from the Current Trends sample

baseline.explanation:
This data contains counts of murder, rape, robbery, and aggravated assault in Chicago for 2024 and 2025.

Definition: NIBRS violent crime is reported here using the UCR-aligned set: murder/nonnegligent manslaughter, rape, robbery, and aggravated assault.

Note: This data comes from the FBI's NIBRS program. Not all agencies report to this system, and some may have incomplete data — especially in their first year of NIBRS reporting or for recent months of data. Always verify that reported offenses are not impacted by incomplete coverage.
baseline.sql: WITH person_crimes AS (SELECT '09A' AS offense_code, 'Murder' AS offense_name, SUM(victim_count) AS count_2025 FROM summary_victim_city_monthly WHERE ucr_offense_code = '09A' AND ori = 'ILCPD0000' AND year = 2025), rape_crimes AS (SELECT '11A/11B/11C' AS offense_code, 'Rape' AS offense_name, SUM(victim_count) AS count_2025 FROM summary_victim_city_monthly WHERE ucr_offense_code IN ('11A','11B','11C') AND ori = 'ILCPD0000' AND year = 2025), agg_assault AS (SELECT '13A' AS offense_code, 'Aggravated Assault' AS offense_name, SUM(victim_count) AS count_2025 FROM summary_victim_city_monthly WHERE ucr_offense_code = '13A' AND ori = 'ILCPD0000' AND year = 2025), robbery AS (SELECT '120' AS offense_code, 'Robbery' AS offense_name, SUM(offense_count) AS count_2025 FROM summary_city_monthly INDEXED BY idx_scm_ori_year WHERE ucr_offense_code = '120' AND ori = 'ILCPD0000' AND year = 2025), all_crimes AS (SELECT * FROM person_crimes UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rape_crimes UNION ALL SELECT * FROM agg_assault UNION ALL SELECT * FROM robbery), prior_year AS (SELECT '09A' AS offense_code, SUM(victim_count) AS count_2024 FROM summary_victim_city_monthly WHERE ucr_offense_code = '09A' AND ori = 'ILCPD0000' AND year = 2024 UNION ALL SELECT '11A/11B/11C', SUM(victim_count) FROM summary_victim_city_monthly WHERE ucr_offense_code IN ('11A','11B','11C') AND ori = 'ILCPD0000' AND year = 2024 UNION ALL SELECT '13A', SUM(victim_count) FROM summary_victim_city_monthly WHERE ucr_offense_code = '13A' AND ori = 'ILCPD0000' AND year = 2024 UNION ALL SELECT '120', SUM(offense_count) FROM summary_city_monthly WHERE ucr_offense_code = '120' AND ori = 'ILCPD0000' AND year = 2024) SELECT ac.offense_name, ac.count_2025, COALESCE(py.count_2024, 0) AS count_2024, COALESCE(ac.count_2025, 0) - COALESCE(py.count_2024, 0) AS change, ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(ac.count_2025, 0) - COALESCE(py.count_2024, 0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(py.count_2024, 0), 0), 1) AS pct_change FROM all_crimes ac LEFT JOIN prior_year py ON py.offense_code = ac.offense_code ORDER BY change ASC LIMIT 1

items.question: show rolling 12-month totals by age group by month from December 2022 to December 2025

request.routing_reason: Incident-level detail, 1991 - present

baseline.explanation: I can't reliably combine data from two different summary tables - joining them would produce incorrect results due to different aggregation grains. I can answer each part separately: for example, I can show victim demographics OR clearance rates, but not both in a single query unless a pre-built combined table exists. Try asking about one dimension at a time, or ask if a specific combination is available.
baseline.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT s.year, s.month, d.age_group, SUM(d.victim_count) AS victim_count
  FROM summary_victim_demographics d
  JOIN summary_victim_city_monthly s ON s.ori = d.ori AND s.year = d.year AND s.ucr_offense_code = d.ucr_offense_code
  WHERE d.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025 AND d.ucr_offense_code IN ('09A','11A','11B','11C','13A','100')
  GROUP BY s.year, s.month, d.age_group
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT DATE('2022-12-01') AS start_date, DATE('2025-12-31') AS end_date
),
spine (year, month) AS (
  SELECT 2021, 10
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN month = 12 THEN year + 1 ELSE year END,
         CASE WHEN month = 12 THEN 1 ELSE month + 1 END
  FROM spine
  WHERE (year < 2025 OR (year = 2025 AND month < 12))
),
monthly_dense AS (
  SELECT s.year, s.month, m.age_group, COALESCE(m.victim_count, 0) AS victim_count
  FROM spine s
  LEFT JOIN monthly m ON m.year = s.year AND m.month = s.month
),
rolling AS (
  SELECT year, month, age_group, victim_count,
    SUM(victim_count) OVER (PARTITION BY age_group ORDER BY year, month ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_12m
  FROM monthly_dense
)
SELECT year, month, age_group, rolling_12m
FROM rolling
WHERE (year > 2022 OR (year = 2022 AND month >= 12)) AND year <= 2025
ORDER BY year, month, age_group LIMIT 1000

chart_config.title: NIBRS murders in Yuma, AZ

baseline.explanation:
This returns reported murders for Yuma, AZ for the requested years. Historical counts are left blank unless the agency reported all 12 months; current-year partial counts remain visible when summary data exists and are disclosed as partial. Months reported are inferred from months containing reported offenses, so this conservative rule can suppress a complete small-agency year with a genuinely offense-free month. Recent annual totals may still change as agencies submit revisions.

Period: 2021-2025.
baseline.sql:
WITH target_places AS (
  SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Yuma, AZ' AS place_label, 'AZ0140500' AS ori, 2021 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Yuma, AZ' AS place_label, 'AZ0140500' AS ori, 2022 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Yuma, AZ' AS place_label, 'AZ0140500' AS ori, 2023 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Yuma, AZ' AS place_label, 'AZ0140500' AS ori, 2024 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Yuma, AZ' AS place_label, 'AZ0140500' AS ori, 2025 AS effective_year
),
requested_years(year) AS (VALUES (2021), (2022), (2023), (2024), (2025)),
current_year_reporting AS (
  SELECT s.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.month) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_victim_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_svcm_ori
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori AND s.year = 2026
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
  GROUP BY s.year
),
place_reporting AS (
  SELECT y.year, MAX(c.months_reported) AS months_reported, MAX(cyr.summary_months_reported) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM requested_years AS y
  CROSS JOIN target_places AS tp
  LEFT JOIN nibrs_agency_completeness AS c INDEXED BY idx_nac_ori_year
    ON c.ori = tp.ori AND c.year = y.year
  LEFT JOIN current_year_reporting AS cyr ON cyr.year = y.year
  WHERE tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = y.year
  GROUP BY y.year
),
annual_counts AS (
  SELECT s.year, SUM(s.victim_count) AS murders
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_victim_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_svcm_ori
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
    AND s.ucr_offense_code = '09A'
    AND s.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
  GROUP BY s.year
)
SELECT pr.year,
  CASE WHEN pr.months_reported = 12 OR (pr.year = 2026 AND (COALESCE(pr.months_reported, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(pr.summary_months_reported, 0) > 0)) THEN COALESCE(ac.murders, 0) ELSE NULL END AS murders
FROM place_reporting AS pr
LEFT JOIN annual_counts AS ac ON ac.year = pr.year
ORDER BY pr.year
LIMIT 1000

request.routing_reason: Incident-level detail, 1991 - present

chart_config.title: NC vs National Violent & Property Crime Decline (2023–2026)

baseline.explanation:
This data contains violent crime and property crime counts and year-over-year percentage changes for North Carolina statewide and the United States, covering 2023 through 2026.

Definition: NIBRS violent crime is reported here using the UCR-aligned set: murder/nonnegligent manslaughter, rape, robbery, and aggravated assault.

Comparison includes: Nc Violent Property, Us Violent Property.

Recent year (2026) may be incomplete or preliminary — NIBRS data are published on a lag, so counts can rise as more agencies report and the recent drop should not be read as a true decline.
baseline.sql: WITH nc_person AS (SELECT year, SUM(victim_count) AS count FROM summary_victim_state_monthly WHERE state = 'NC' AND ucr_offense_code IN ('09A','11A','11B','11C','13A','100') GROUP BY year), nc_property AS (SELECT year, SUM(offense_count) AS count FROM summary_state_monthly WHERE state = 'NC' AND ucr_offense_code IN ('120','200','220','23A','23B','23C','23D','23E','23F','23G','23H','240') GROUP BY year), nc_combined AS (SELECT year, SUM(count) AS nc_violent_property FROM (SELECT year, count FROM nc_person UNION ALL SELECT year, count FROM nc_property) GROUP BY year), us_person AS (SELECT year, SUM(victim_count) AS count FROM summary_victim_state_monthly WHERE ucr_offense_code IN ('09A','11A','11B','11C','13A','100') GROUP BY year), us_property AS (SELECT year, SUM(offense_count) AS count FROM summary_state_monthly WHERE ucr_offense_code IN ('120','200','220','23A','23B','23C','23D','23E','23F','23G','23H','240') GROUP BY year), us_combined AS (SELECT year, SUM(count) AS us_violent_property FROM (SELECT year, count FROM us_person UNION ALL SELECT year, count FROM us_property) GROUP BY year), with_lag AS (SELECT nc.year, nc.nc_violent_property, us.us_violent_property, LAG(nc.nc_violent_property) OVER (ORDER BY nc.year) AS nc_prior, LAG(us.us_violent_property) OVER (ORDER BY us.year) AS us_prior FROM nc_combined nc JOIN us_combined us ON us.year = nc.year) SELECT CAST(year AS TEXT) AS year, nc_violent_property, us_violent_property, ROUND(100.0 * (nc_prior - nc_violent_property) / nc_prior, 1) AS nc_pct_change, ROUND(100.0 * (us_prior - us_violent_property) / us_prior, 1) AS us_pct_change FROM with_lag WHERE year >= 2023 ORDER BY year LIMIT 1000

chart_config.title: NIBRS offense rate trends for White Plains, NY

baseline.explanation:
This returns annual reported aggravated assaults rates per 100,000 for White Plains, NY for the requested years. Named city police departments are resolved to city-agency ORIs; named sheriff agencies are resolved through the agency crosswalk. Person crimes use victim summaries while robbery and other non-person offenses use offense summaries. Rates use each agency's year-specific service population and are left blank unless the agency reported all 12 months. Recent annual values may still change as agencies submit revisions.

Period: 2021-2025.
baseline.sql:
WITH target_places AS (
  SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'White Plains, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0590200' AS ori, 2021 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'White Plains, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0590200' AS ori, 2022 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'White Plains, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0590200' AS ori, 2023 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'White Plains, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0590200' AS ori, 2024 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'White Plains, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0590200' AS ori, 2025 AS effective_year
),
offense_counts_1 AS (
  SELECT s.year, tp.place_key, SUM(s.victim_count) AS reported_count
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_victim_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_svcm_ori
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
    AND s.ucr_offense_code = '13A'
    AND s.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
  GROUP BY s.year, tp.place_key
),
requested_years(year) AS (VALUES (2021), (2022), (2023), (2024), (2025)),
current_year_reporting AS (
  SELECT tp.place_key, COUNT(DISTINCT s.month) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_scm_ori_year
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori AND s.year = 2026
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
  GROUP BY tp.place_key
),
place_reporting AS (
  SELECT y.year, tp.place_key, MAX(a.population) AS population, MAX(c.months_reported) AS months_reported, MAX(cyr.summary_months_reported) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM requested_years AS y
  CROSS JOIN target_places AS tp
  LEFT JOIN agencies AS a ON a.ori = tp.ori AND a.year = y.year AND a.population > 0
  LEFT JOIN nibrs_agency_completeness AS c INDEXED BY idx_nac_ori_year
    ON c.ori = tp.ori AND c.year = y.year
  LEFT JOIN current_year_reporting AS cyr ON cyr.place_key = tp.place_key AND y.year = 2026
  WHERE tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = y.year
  GROUP BY y.year, tp.place_key
)
SELECT pr.year,
  CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.months_reported END) = 12 THEN ROUND(100000.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN oc1.place_key = 'place_1' THEN oc1.reported_count END), 0) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.population END), 0), 1) ELSE NULL END AS white_plains_ny_aggravated_assaults_rate_per_100k
FROM place_reporting AS pr
LEFT JOIN offense_counts_1 AS oc1 ON oc1.year = pr.year AND oc1.place_key = pr.place_key
GROUP BY pr.year
ORDER BY pr.year
LIMIT 1000

items.question: Houston vehicle burglaries by year and clearance status, 2018 to 2026

request.routing_reason: Only NIBRS tracks vehicle burglary — other sources don't have this offense

chart_config.title: Thefts from vehicles and clearances, Houston, TX, 2019-2025

baseline.explanation:
Theft from a motor vehicle (NIBRS offense 23F) -- articles taken from a vehicle, which many departments call burglary of a motor vehicle. It is not burglary of a building (220), theft of the vehicle itself (240), or theft of its parts and accessories (23G).

Clearance here means cleared by arrest or by exceptional means, as recorded by the FBI; it is not the same as a conviction.

Complete 12-month reporting years: 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025.

Clearance note: FBI clearance means cleared by arrest or exceptional means; it is not the same as conviction or prosecution.

Comparison includes: Cleared, Not Cleared.

Although the query covered 2018 onward, this source returned data beginning in 2019.

No figure is given for 2018: only part of that year was reported, and this source does not record which months.

No figure is given for 2026: the yearly and monthly records disagree about how many offenses there were.
baseline.sql:
WITH requested_years(year) AS (VALUES (2018), (2019), (2020), (2021), (2022), (2023), (2024), (2025), (2026)),
annual AS (
  SELECT scd.year, scd.total_offenses, scd.cleared_by_arrest + scd.cleared_A + scd.cleared_B + scd.cleared_C + scd.cleared_D + scd.cleared_E AS cleared,
    MIN(scd.cleared_by_arrest, scd.cleared_A, scd.cleared_B, scd.cleared_C, scd.cleared_D, scd.cleared_E) AS min_component
  FROM summary_clearance_detail scd INDEXED BY idx_scd_ori_year
  WHERE scd.ori = 'TXHPD0000' AND scd.ucr_offense_code = '23F'
    AND scd.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2026
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT s.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.month) AS months_with_data,
    SUM(s.offense_count) AS monthly_offenses, SUM(s.cleared_count) AS monthly_cleared
  FROM summary_city_monthly s INDEXED BY idx_scm_ori_year
  WHERE s.ori = 'TXHPD0000' AND s.ucr_offense_code = '23F'
    AND s.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2026
  GROUP BY s.year
),
reporting AS (
  SELECT nac.year, nac.months_reported
  FROM nibrs_agency_completeness nac INDEXED BY idx_nac_ori_year
  WHERE nac.ori = 'TXHPD0000'
    AND nac.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2026
)
SELECT y.year AS year,
  a.total_offenses AS total_offenses,
  a.cleared AS cleared,
  a.total_offenses - a.cleared AS not_cleared,
  ROUND(100.0 * a.cleared / NULLIF(a.total_offenses, 0), 1) AS clearance_rate,
  a.min_component AS min_component,
  r.months_reported AS months_reported,
  m.months_with_data AS months_with_data,
  m.monthly_offenses AS monthly_offenses,
  m.monthly_cleared AS monthly_cleared
FROM requested_years y
LEFT JOIN annual a ON a.year = y.year
LEFT JOIN monthly m ON m.year = y.year
LEFT JOIN reporting r ON r.year = y.year
ORDER BY y.year

items.question: Allentown murder rate 2026

request.routing_reason: Recent monthly data from the Current Trends sample

baseline.explanation:
This returns annual reported murders rates per 100,000 for Allentown, PA for the requested year. Named city police departments are resolved to city-agency ORIs; named sheriff agencies are resolved through the agency crosswalk. Person crimes use victim summaries while robbery and other non-person offenses use offense summaries. Rates use each agency's year-specific service population and are left blank unless the agency reported all 12 months. Recent annual values may still change as agencies submit revisions.

Period: 2026.

Allentown, PA, 2026: the rate is left blank because the NIBRS completeness record shows 1 of 12 months reported for 2026, and a rate is shown only for a year with all 12. Summary data show offense activity in January, February, March, April, May, June, July; months with recorded offenses are a proxy, not certified reporting coverage.
baseline.sql:
WITH target_places AS (
  SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Allentown, PA' AS place_label, 'PA0390100' AS ori, 2026 AS effective_year
),
offense_counts_1 AS (
  SELECT s.year, tp.place_key, SUM(s.victim_count) AS reported_count
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_victim_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_svcm_ori
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
    AND s.ucr_offense_code = '09A'
    AND s.year = 2026
  GROUP BY s.year, tp.place_key
),
requested_years(year) AS (VALUES (2026)),
current_year_reporting AS (
  SELECT tp.place_key, COUNT(DISTINCT s.month) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_scm_ori_year
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori AND s.year = 2026
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
  GROUP BY tp.place_key
),
place_reporting AS (
  SELECT y.year, tp.place_key, MAX(a.population) AS population, MAX(c.months_reported) AS months_reported, MAX(cyr.summary_months_reported) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM requested_years AS y
  CROSS JOIN target_places AS tp
  LEFT JOIN agencies AS a ON a.ori = tp.ori AND a.year = y.year AND a.population > 0
  LEFT JOIN nibrs_agency_completeness AS c INDEXED BY idx_nac_ori_year
    ON c.ori = tp.ori AND c.year = y.year
  LEFT JOIN current_year_reporting AS cyr ON cyr.place_key = tp.place_key AND y.year = 2026
  WHERE tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = y.year
  GROUP BY y.year, tp.place_key
)
,observed_months AS (
  SELECT tp.place_key, s.year, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.month) AS activity_months, COUNT(DISTINCT s.ori) AS activity_oris
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_scm_ori_year
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori AND s.year IN (SELECT year FROM requested_years)
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
  GROUP BY tp.place_key, s.year
)
SELECT pr.year,
  CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.months_reported END) = 12 THEN ROUND(100000.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN oc1.place_key = 'place_1' THEN oc1.reported_count END), 0) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.population END), 0), 1) ELSE NULL END AS allentown_pa_murders_rate_per_100k,
  MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.months_reported END) AS meta_place_1_months_reported,
  MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.population END) AS meta_place_1_population,
  MAX(CASE WHEN om.place_key = 'place_1' THEN om.activity_months END) AS meta_place_1_activity_months,
  MAX(CASE WHEN om.place_key = 'place_1' THEN om.activity_oris END) AS meta_place_1_activity_oris
FROM place_reporting AS pr
LEFT JOIN offense_counts_1 AS oc1 ON oc1.year = pr.year AND oc1.place_key = pr.place_key
LEFT JOIN observed_months AS om ON om.year = pr.year AND om.place_key = pr.place_key
GROUP BY pr.year
ORDER BY pr.year

selected_agencies AS (
  SELECT 'San Francisco Police Department' AS place_label, ty.ori AS ori, ty.year AS effective_year FROM target_years ty
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target_data)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT pc.place_label AS place_label, pc.ori AS ori, NULL AS effective_year FROM peer_candidates pc
),
clearances AS (
  SELECT sct.year, sa.place_label, sa.ori,
    SUM(sct.total_offenses) AS total_offenses,
    SUM(sct.cleared_by_arrest) AS cleared_by_arrest,
    SUM(sct.cleared_exceptional) AS cleared_exceptional
  FROM selected_agencies sa
  CROSS JOIN summary_clearance_type sct INDEXED BY idx_sct_ori_year
  WHERE sct.ori = sa.ori
    AND (sa.effective_year IS NULL OR sa.effective_year = sct.year)
    AND sct.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
    AND sct.ucr_offense_code IN ('11A', '11B', '11C')
  GROUP BY sct.year, sa.place_label, sa.ori
)
SELECT year, place_label, ori,
  total_offenses,
  cleared_by_arrest,
  cleared_exceptional,
  ROUND(100.0 * (cleared_by_arrest + cleared_exceptional) / NULLIF(total_offenses, 0), 1) AS clearance_rate_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * cleared_by_arrest / NULLIF(total_offenses, 0), 1) AS arrest_rate_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * cleared_exceptional / NULLIF(total_offenses, 0), 1) AS exceptional_rate_pct
FROM clearances
ORDER BY year, place_label
LIMIT 1000

chart_config.title: Denver Police Department clearance rates and similar-size agencies

baseline.explanation:
This compares rapes clearance rates for Denver Police Department with its population peers. Peers were selected on population alone — the 3 agencies closest in size to Denver Police Department, CO (733,212). The comparison covers populations from 691,630 to 733,212, and includes NASHVILLE, TN, WASHINGTON, DC and LOUISVILLE, KY. The overall rate includes arrest and exceptional clearances. Peer selection is based on agency service population, not broader socioeconomic similarity. Recent NIBRS data may be incomplete.

Clearance note: FBI clearance means cleared by arrest or exceptional means; it is not the same as conviction or prosecution.

Period: 2021-2025.
baseline.sql:
WITH
target_years AS (
  SELECT 2021 AS year, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 740209 AS population
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2022 AS year, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 705264 AS population
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2023 AS year, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 712222 AS population
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2024 AS year, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 722031 AS population
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2025 AS year, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 733212 AS population
),
peer_selected AS (
  SELECT 'TN0190100' AS ori, 'NASHVILLE, TN' AS place_label
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'DCMPD0000' AS ori, 'WASHINGTON, DC' AS place_label
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'KY0568000' AS ori, 'LOUISVILLE, KY' AS place_label
),
target_data AS (
  SELECT 1 AS available
  FROM target_years ty
  CROSS JOIN summary_clearance_type target_probe INDEXED BY idx_sct_ori_year
  WHERE target_probe.ori = ty.ori
    AND target_probe.year = ty.year
    AND target_probe.ucr_offense_code IN ('11A', '11B', '11C')
  LIMIT 1
),
peer_candidates AS (
  SELECT ps.ori AS ori, ps.place_label AS place_label
  FROM peer_selected ps
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target_data)
),
selected_agencies AS (
  SELECT 'Denver Police Department' AS place_label, ty.ori AS ori, ty.year AS effective_year FROM target_years ty
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target_data)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT pc.place_label AS place_label, pc.ori AS ori, NULL AS effective_year FROM peer_candidates pc
),
clearances AS (
  SELECT sct.year, sa.place_label, sa.ori,
    SUM(sct.total_offenses) AS total_offenses,
    SUM(sct.cleared_by_arrest) AS cleared_by_arrest,
    SUM(sct.cleared_exceptional) AS cleared_exceptional
  FROM selected_agencies sa
  CROSS JOIN summary_clearance_type sct INDEXED BY idx_sct_ori_year
  WHERE sct.ori = sa.ori
    AND (sa.effective_year IS NULL OR sa.effective_year = sct.year)
    AND sct.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
    AND sct.ucr_offense_code IN ('11A', '11B', '11C')
  GROUP BY sct.year, sa.place_label, sa.ori
)
SELECT year, place_label, ori,
  total_offenses,
  cleared_by_arrest,
  cleared_exceptional,
  ROUND(100.0 * (cleared_by_arrest + cleared_exceptional) / NULLIF(total_offenses, 0), 1) AS clearance_rate_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * cleared_by_arrest / NULLIF(total_offenses, 0), 1) AS arrest_rate_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * cleared_exceptional / NULLIF(total_offenses, 0), 1) AS exceptional_rate_pct
FROM clearances
ORDER BY year, place_label
LIMIT 1000

baseline.explanation:
This returns annual reported murders rates per 100,000 for Allentown, PA for the requested year. Named city police departments are resolved to city-agency ORIs; named sheriff agencies are resolved through the agency crosswalk. Person crimes use victim summaries while robbery and other non-person offenses use offense summaries. Rates use each agency's year-specific service population and are left blank unless the agency reported all 12 months. Recent annual values may still change as agencies submit revisions.

Period: 2026.

Allentown, PA, 2026: the rate is left blank because the NIBRS completeness record shows 1 of 12 months reported for 2026, and a rate is shown only for a year with all 12. Summary data show offense activity in January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August; months with recorded offenses are a proxy, not certified reporting coverage.
baseline.sql:
WITH target_places AS (
  SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Allentown, PA' AS place_label, 'PA0390100' AS ori, 2026 AS effective_year
),
offense_counts_1 AS (
  SELECT s.year, tp.place_key, SUM(s.victim_count) AS reported_count
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_victim_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_svcm_ori
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
    AND s.ucr_offense_code = '09A'
    AND s.year = 2026
  GROUP BY s.year, tp.place_key
),
requested_years(year) AS (VALUES (2026)),
current_year_reporting AS (
  SELECT tp.place_key, COUNT(DISTINCT s.month) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_scm_ori_year
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori AND s.year = 2026
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
  GROUP BY tp.place_key
),

  LEFT JOIN agencies AS a ON a.ori = tp.ori AND a.year = y.year AND a.population > 0
  LEFT JOIN nibrs_agency_completeness AS c INDEXED BY idx_nac_ori_year
    ON c.ori = tp.ori AND c.year = y.year

)

  FROM target_places AS tp

SELECT pr.year,

baseline.explanation: Chicago, IL, 2024 to 2025: among the violent crime categories with records in both years, robbery (120) decreased the most, from 8,874 to 5,682 offenses (−3,192). Units differ by category, as this product counts them: victims for the crimes against persons, offenses for robbery. Excluded from the comparison: 0 of 1 agency for Chicago, IL. chart_config.title: Chicago, IL Murders clearances by type

baseline.explanation:
Every clearance category for Murders in Chicago, IL for the requested year, with uncleared offenses shown as their own category so the parts sum to the reported total. FBI clearance means cleared by arrest or exceptional means; it is not a conviction. Recent NIBRS data may be incomplete.

Clearance note: FBI clearance means cleared by arrest or exceptional means; it is not the same as conviction or prosecution.

Period: 2025.
baseline.sql:
WITH totals AS (
  SELECT scd.year AS year,
    SUM(scd.total_offenses) AS total_offenses,
    SUM(scd.cleared_by_arrest) AS cleared_by_arrest,
    SUM(scd.cleared_A) AS cleared_a,
    SUM(scd.cleared_B) AS cleared_b,
    SUM(scd.cleared_C) AS cleared_c,
    SUM(scd.cleared_D) AS cleared_d,
    SUM(scd.cleared_E) AS cleared_e
  FROM summary_clearance_detail scd INDEXED BY idx_scd_ori_year
  WHERE scd.ucr_offense_code = '09A'
    AND scd.year = 2025
    AND scd.ori IN ('ILCPD0000')
  GROUP BY scd.year
)
SELECT year, clearance_type, offenses FROM (
  SELECT t.year AS year, 'Cleared by arrest' AS clearance_type, t.cleared_by_arrest AS offenses FROM totals t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.year AS year, 'Death of offender' AS clearance_type, t.cleared_a AS offenses FROM totals t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.year AS year, 'Prosecution declined' AS clearance_type, t.cleared_b AS offenses FROM totals t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.year AS year, 'In custody elsewhere' AS clearance_type, t.cleared_c AS offenses FROM totals t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.year AS year, 'Victim refused to cooperate' AS clearance_type, t.cleared_d AS offenses FROM totals t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.year AS year, 'Juvenile, no custody' AS clearance_type, t.cleared_e AS offenses FROM totals t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.year AS year, 'Not cleared' AS clearance_type, t.total_offenses - (t.cleared_by_arrest + t.cleared_a + t.cleared_b + t.cleared_c + t.cleared_d + t.cleared_e) AS offenses FROM totals t
)
ORDER BY year, CASE clearance_type WHEN 'Cleared by arrest' THEN 1 WHEN 'Death of offender' THEN 2 WHEN 'Prosecution declined' THEN 3 WHEN 'In custody elsewhere' THEN 4 WHEN 'Victim refused to cooperate' THEN 5 WHEN 'Juvenile, no custody' THEN 6 WHEN 'Not cleared' THEN 7 END
LIMIT 1000

items.question: show me violent crimes by year by offender age for 2017 to 2025 for continuously reporting agencies

request.routing_reason: Incident-level detail, 1991 - present

chart_config.title: Continuous-reporting NIBRS offenders by age group

baseline.explanation:
This shows offenders by age group from 2017 through 2025, restricted to agencies that reported all 12 months in every complete year from 2017 through 2025. NIBRS participation still limits comparability outside this fixed agency set.

Definition: NIBRS violent crime is reported here using the UCR-aligned set: murder/nonnegligent manslaughter, rape, robbery, and aggravated assault.

Coverage filter: Results are restricted to agencies that reported all 12 months in every requested year. These are individual reporting agencies, not geographic totals; this improves year-to-year comparability but is not a national estimate.
baseline.sql:
SELECT
  d.year,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.age_group), ''), 'Unknown') AS age_group,
  SUM(d.offender_count) AS offenders
FROM summary_offender_demographics d
WHERE d.ucr_offense_code IN ('09A', '11A', '11B', '11C', '120', '13A')
  AND d.year BETWEEN 2017 AND 2025
  AND d.ori IN (SELECT ori FROM nibrs_consistent_reporters WHERE start_year = 2017 AND end_year = 2025)
GROUP BY d.year, age_group
ORDER BY d.year, age_group
LIMIT 1000

items.question: Murders in Manhattan, KS in 2025

request.routing_reason: Recent monthly data from the Current Trends sample

baseline.explanation:
This returns reported murders for Manhattan, KS for the requested year. Historical counts are left blank unless the agency reported all 12 months; current-year partial counts remain visible when summary data exists and are disclosed as partial. Months reported are inferred from months containing reported offenses, so this conservative rule can suppress a complete small-agency year with a genuinely offense-free month. Recent annual totals may still change as agencies submit revisions.

Period: 2025.
baseline.sql:
WITH target_places AS (
  SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Manhattan, KS' AS place_label, 'KS0810000' AS ori, 2025 AS effective_year
),
requested_years(year) AS (VALUES (2025)),
current_year_reporting AS (
  SELECT s.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.month) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_victim_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_svcm_ori
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori AND s.year = 2026
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
  GROUP BY s.year
),
place_reporting AS (
  SELECT y.year, MAX(c.months_reported) AS months_reported, MAX(cyr.summary_months_reported) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM requested_years AS y
  CROSS JOIN target_places AS tp
  LEFT JOIN nibrs_agency_completeness AS c INDEXED BY idx_nac_ori_year
    ON c.ori = tp.ori AND c.year = y.year
  LEFT JOIN current_year_reporting AS cyr ON cyr.year = y.year
  WHERE tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = y.year
  GROUP BY y.year
),
annual_counts AS (
  SELECT s.year, SUM(s.victim_count) AS murders
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_victim_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_svcm_ori
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
    AND s.ucr_offense_code = '09A'
    AND s.year = 2025
  GROUP BY s.year
)
SELECT pr.year,
  CASE WHEN pr.months_reported = 12 OR (pr.year = 2026 AND (COALESCE(pr.months_reported, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(pr.summary_months_reported, 0) > 0)) THEN COALESCE(ac.murders, 0) ELSE NULL END AS murders
FROM place_reporting AS pr
LEFT JOIN annual_counts AS ac ON ac.year = pr.year
ORDER BY pr.year
LIMIT 1000

baseline.sql: SELECT a.city AS city, a.state AS state, SUM(s.offense_count) AS offenses, a.population AS population, ROUND(SUM(s.offense_count) * 100000.0 / a.population, 2) AS rate_per_100k, MIN(s.month) AS first_month, MAX(s.month) AS last_month FROM summary_city_monthly s JOIN agencies a ON a.ori = s.ori AND a.year = s.year WHERE s.ucr_offense_code IN ('09A') AND s.year = 2026 AND a.agency_type = 'City' AND s.month <= 10 AND a.population > 0 GROUP BY a.ori, a.city, a.state, a.population ORDER BY rate_per_100k DESC LIMIT 100

baseline.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT s.ori AS ori, SUM(s.victim_count) AS murders, MIN(s.year) AS first_year, MAX(s.year) AS last_year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.year) AS years_with_records FROM summary_victim_city_monthly s WHERE s.ucr_offense_code = '09A' AND s.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2026 AND (s.year < 2026 OR s.month <= 10) GROUP BY s.ori), places AS (SELECT a.ori AS ori, a.city AS city, a.state AS state, a.agency_type AS agency_type, MAX(a.year) AS label_year FROM agencies a JOIN totals t ON t.ori = a.ori WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2026 GROUP BY a.ori), names AS (SELECT c.ori9 AS ori, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.agency_name) = 1 THEN MAX(c.agency_name) END AS agency_name FROM agency_county_crosswalk c JOIN totals t ON t.ori = c.ori9 GROUP BY c.ori9) SELECT n.agency_name AS agency_name, pl.city AS city, pl.state AS state, pl.agency_type AS agency_type, t.ori AS ori, CASE WHEN n.agency_name IS NOT NULL AND pl.state IS NOT NULL THEN n.agency_name || ', ' || pl.state || ' (' || t.ori || ')' WHEN n.agency_name IS NOT NULL THEN n.agency_name || ' (' || t.ori || ')' WHEN pl.city IS NOT NULL AND pl.city <> '' AND pl.state IS NOT NULL AND pl.state <> '' THEN pl.city || ', ' || pl.state || ', ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(pl.agency_type, ''), 'unrecorded type') || ' agency (' || t.ori || ')' WHEN pl.ori IS NOT NULL THEN 'ORI ' || t.ori || ' (no place recorded)' ELSE 'ORI ' || t.ori || ' (no NIBRS agency record)' END AS agency_label, t.murders AS murders, t.first_year AS first_year, t.last_year AS last_year, t.years_with_records AS years_with_records FROM totals t LEFT JOIN places pl ON pl.ori = t.ori LEFT JOIN names n ON n.ori = t.ori ORDER BY t.murders DESC, t.ori ASC LIMIT 10

chart_config.title: NIBRS offenses in Denver, CO

baseline.explanation:
This returns reported offenses for Denver, CO for the requested years. Recent monthly NIBRS data may be incomplete because agencies submit on different schedules.

Returned period: January 2018-September 2026.

The 2026 figures cover January-September 2026.
baseline.sql:
WITH target_places AS (
  SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2018 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2019 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2020 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2021 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2022 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2023 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2024 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2025 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2026 AS effective_year
)
SELECT s.year, s.month, SUM(s.offense_count) AS offenses
FROM target_places AS tp
CROSS JOIN summary_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_scm_ori_year
WHERE s.ucr_offense_code = '23F'
  AND s.state = 'CO'
  AND s.year >= 2018
  AND s.ori = tp.ori
  AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
GROUP BY s.year, s.month
ORDER BY s.year, s.month
LIMIT 1000

chart_config.title: Denver, CO Thefts From Vehicles Per Month, 2018 to 2026

baseline.explanation:
This returns reported thefts from vehicles for Denver, CO for the requested years. Recent monthly NIBRS data may be incomplete because agencies submit on different schedules.

Returned period: January 2018-September 2026.

The 2026 figures cover January-September 2026.
baseline.sql:
WITH target_places AS (
  SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2018 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2019 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2020 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2021 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2022 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2023 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2024 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2025 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2026 AS effective_year
)
SELECT s.year, s.month, SUM(s.offense_count) AS offenses
FROM target_places AS tp
CROSS JOIN summary_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_scm_ori_year
WHERE s.ucr_offense_code = '23F'
  AND s.state = 'CO'
  AND s.year >= 2018
  AND s.ori = tp.ori
  AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
GROUP BY s.year, s.month
ORDER BY s.year, s.month
LIMIT 1000

chart_config.title: Continuous-reporting NIBRS offenders by age group

baseline.explanation:
This shows offenders by age group from 2018 through 2025, restricted to agencies that reported all 12 months in every complete year from 2018 through 2025. NIBRS participation still limits comparability outside this fixed agency set.

  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.age_group), ''), 'Unknown') AS age_group,

FROM summary_offender_demographics d
WHERE d.ucr_offense_code IN ('09A', '11A', '11B', '11C', '120', '13A')
  AND d.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2025
  AND d.ori IN (SELECT ori FROM nibrs_consistent_reporters WHERE start_year = 2018 AND end_year = 2025)
GROUP BY d.year, age_group
ORDER BY d.year, age_group
LIMIT 1000
